To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we introduce the problem of review selection, formalize it as a combinatoric optimization problem, and propose efficient approximation algorithms to address the problem; we evaluate the proposed algorithms with real review corporas and show that our approach outperforms existing methods; and our user studies show that the selected reviews are more informative than existing methods and are preferred over the full review corpus by the users.
(1) selecting a small set of reviews is a hard problem, and (2) our algorithms provide a better summary of review corpora than existing methods.

we propose a novel approach to select a small set of reviews that together represent the entire review corpus, we show that this problem is NP-hard, and we design algorithms that work well in practice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of extracting a small set of reviews from large corpora, which can be used to provide a concise and accurate summary.
a fundamental question in information retrieval: How can one select the most informative reviews from an entire set of reviews? Our work is the first to provide an effective answer.
a novel and practical problem, we formulate it formally and provide efficient algorithms to solve the problem, and our experiments show that our methods outperform the state-of-the-art.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is able to provide a better review summary than existing methods.
we have developed a new approach to summarizing reviews that preserves the statistical characteristics of the review corpus.
our methods provide the most comprehensive and detailed summary of a large number of reviews.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our methods provide an alternative to review summarization and review selection that preserves the richness of the original review corpus.
, given a large set of reviews, our approach can identify a small set of reviews that together capture the statistical properties of all reviews.
we propose to select a characteristic set of online reviews that can be read in seconds, yet captures the most important information about products.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a small subset of carefully selected reviews can be a useful substitute for the entire review corpus.
the problem of selecting representative reviews from a corpus is a non-trivial problem, which can be solved by our methods.
we can select a small subset of online reviews, and together they provide an accurate summary of the entire review set.
